summary: Pre-deployment QA audit for MASCI HUB on preview (https://backup-forensics.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified: TALLY bar regression FIXED on mobile (390x844) — bar at y=700-748, Emergent badge at y=788-828, ZERO vertical overlap; restore chip clicks normally without force. Branding/footer wording correct on every surface checked: '/' shows 'PLATFORM DEVELOPED BY THE JUDD GROUP LLC · TERMS · PRIVACY'; /admin/login, /pm/login, /shop/login all show 'PLATFORM DEVELOPED BY THE JUDD GROUP LLC'; admin hub (post-login) shows 'SYSTEM DEVELOPED & MAINTAINED BY THE JUDD GROUP LLC'. Forbidden phrases ('Powered by The Judd', 'A subsidiary of', 'Proprietary platform developed and maintained', 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED', 'Built with Emergent') = ZERO occurrences in user-visible content or JS bundle. Terms = 14 numbered sections (1..14), Flagler County wording present, 'EFFECTIVE DATE: JANUARY 01, 2026' rendered (CSS-uppercased). Privacy = 11 sections, 'MongoDB Atlas' + 'Resend' subprocessors named. Training PDFs (EN+ES, /api/training/packet.pdf?track=field) both 480-490 KB, 10 pages, footer '© MASCI · Platform developed by The Judd Group LLC' on every page, disclaimer appears once on last page only, last page has mascidocs.com + customer-branded-deployment attribution, ZERO 'Emergent' or 'Powered by' in extracted text. Route aliases /reports/daily/new, /safety/jha, /safety/trench-boxes all 200. Security: /api/admin/* and /api/daily-reports return 401 without token; public POST endpoints (/api/inspections, /api/equipment-inspections) reject malformed bodies with 422 Pydantic validation. Secrets scan of bundle.js: real values for sk-emergent-..., re_CfHQ..., ADMIN_HMAC_SECRET value, JWT_SECRET value = ZERO hits (env var NAMES appear only inside admin docs strings, not values).

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge present on every preview page. This is the platform-injected Emergent badge anchored to bottom-right; it is EXPECTED on preview/*.emergentagent.com URLs and will NOT appear on production mascidocs.com. NOT a code bug — flagged only for awareness; spec acknowledges this in problem statement.

action_items: None blocking deployment. Optional: confirm mascidocs.com production deploy env has AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=true, RATE_LIMITING=on, CORS_ORIGINS=https://mascidocs.com,https://www.mascidocs.com (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md hardening notes).
critical_code_review_comments: TALLY bar fix (NewEquipmentInspection.jsx) is correctly applied — sticky bar lifted above Emergent badge zone on mobile. Restore chip is now reachable with a normal click.

All required attribution strings render with `text-transform: uppercase` CSS, but the underlying source-text is sentence-cased ('Platform developed by The Judd Group LLC'). Programmatic substring checks against innerText must use uppercase form. Document this for future agents.
/api/training/packet (no .pdf suffix) returns 404 — the actual route is /api/training/packet.pdf. The original problem statement curl lacked .pdf; agents should use the .pdf suffix.

bundle.js is the unminified CRA dev bundle (~7.5 MB). For prod deploy at mascidocs.com, ensure CI runs `yarn build` (not dev server) so main.*.js minified bundle is shipped — current preview ships dev bundle which is >2 MB.
